svg.title: Barekube platform
svg.desc: Barekube is the low-level k3s foundation on your bare-metal Linux nodes: k3s, WireGuard network, gVisor sandbox and Longhorn storage prerequisites. Your platform is built on top. An optional console, run from a Docker image, manages the nodes through a small node-agent installed on each one.
svg.text: built on top of barekube - examples only, your choice
low-level k3s platform for bare metal - one CLI, every node
your cluster - as many nodes as you need
manages, over HTTPS with a pinned certificate
Docker image, compose file, off by default
